about: Nothing reaches the network: with no host faked, a command the Rust core answers itself (the updater) and one the Node core answers (paper) both refuse the request before connecting. Guards SPAWNLOFT_TEST_ORIGINS on both sides, so a Rust-owned client that forgets test_origins::rewrite is caught.

expect.stdoutIncludes: SPAWNLOFT_TEST_ORIGINS has no fake for https://api.github.com; the request was not sent

expect.stderrIncludes: SPAWNLOFT_TEST_ORIGINS has no fake for https://fill.papermc.io
